subject: Draft MAP: security onboarding cadence & DPA retention carveouts
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Connors <michael.connors@arcfin.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Draft MAP & proposed security onboarding cadence (SOC 2 / SIG / DPA)

Mike — attaching a first-pass mutual action plan for ArcFin's evaluation and a short onboarding cadence that ties security gates to acceptance criteria. High level: 

- Week 0: Kickoff + access provisioning (test account, API keys scoped)
- Week 1–2: Evidence intake (SOC 2 report, SIG/CAIQ mapping, DPA redline)
- Week 3: Security sprint for open items; engineering demo with telemetry
- Week 4: Acceptance window and handoff to procurement/legal for DPA/PO

Acceptance criteria we propose for go/no-go: SOC 2 Type II report within past 12 months or SOC 2 bookkeeping plan + remediation timeline; SIG/CAIQ mapping with evidence links for controls in scope; executed DPA with standard data retention carveouts documented. See attached: ArcFin-MAP-draft-v1.pdf for milestones and responsibilities.

Questions for you:
1) Does the proposed 3-week evidence sprint work with your internal timeline?
2) Can you confirm the SOC 2 period ArcFin requires (past 12 months vs. rolling 12-month)?
3) Any EU-specific retention carveouts we should pre-empt (we can propose an EU data handling annex if needed)?

Attaching: ArcFin-MAP-draft-v1.pdf (MAP), SOC2-report-2026Q2.pdf (previous public report stub), SIG-CAIQ-mapping.xlsx (blank template).

Thanks — let me know a good time for a 30-minute kickoff this week.

—Neha
Neha Kapoor

From: Michael Connors <michael.connors@arcfin.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emma Lee <emma.lee@arcfin.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 14:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft MAP & proposed security onboarding cadence (SOC 2 / SIG / DPA)

Neha — thanks for the clear plan and attachments. A few items from our side before we lock dates: 

1) SOC 2: our legal team prefers a Type II report covering the most recent 12-month period; in absence of a Type II we need a bridge letter + remediation milestones.
2) SIG/CAIQ: we absolutely need the mapping with evidence links for these controls: IA-2, CM-3, SI-4, and the data handling questions (D1–D4). Can you populate the SIG spreadsheet with links to the artifacts (reports, runbooks)?
3) DPA: the key snag for us is subprocessor disclosure and the default retention for logs — we need logs stored for 180 days for forensic purposes and a separate shorter window for PII derived caches. Can Redwood accept a carveout or annex for our regulated products?

Looping in Emma (legal) so she can review the DPA redline and confirm the retention ask. Also, if you can confirm the evidence intake sprint won't require privileged access to production (we'll only provide read-only logs and a reproducible dataset), that will speed approvals.

Proposed next step: 30-minute kickoff next Monday (11/16) to align scope and confirm a DPA cadence.

—Michael
Michael Connors
Head of Platform Risk, ArcFin
michael.connors@arcfin.com
+1 (212) 555-0199

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft MAP & proposed security onboarding cadence (SOC 2 / SIG / DPA)

Neha / team — answering Michael's points and proposing concrete artifacts.

SOC 2: Redwood can provide a Type II report covering the period 2025-12 through 2026-11 (see SOC2-report-2026Q2.pdf attached as the redacted summary). If ArcFin needs the full report with auditor appendix we can request legal release — typically a brief NDA + verified contact is sufficient.

SIG/CAIQ: I've populated the mapping with our evidence pointers and initial links in the shared Drive (SIG-CAIQ-mapping.xlsx). We will not provide production credentials; evidence will be captured via: read-only log exports, config snapshots, runbook extracts, and sample API traces pulled to a sandbox. That satisfies the evidence for IA-2/CM-3/SI-4 and the data handling controls.

DPA & retention carveout: attached is our standard DPA redline (Redline-DPA-ArcFin.docx). We are open to an annex that specifies:
- Forensic logs retention: 180 days (read-only exports available on request)
- Short-term caches holding PII-derived artifacts: 30 days by default, configurable per-customer with additional cost for extended caches
- Subprocessors: full disclosure list + 30-day notification for changes; we can add a clause for ArcFin-specific subprocessors if required.

Acceptance criteria (proposed):
- SOC 2 Type II report or executed NDA for full report (Day 3)
- SIG mapping with evidence links (Day 7)
- DPA redline completed and DocuSign link issued (Day 14)
- Engineering demo with production-like telemetry and a runbook walkthrough (Day 18)

I recommend we run the evidence sprint Tue 11/17–Fri 11/27 (two weeks) and schedule the legal/PO handoff for week of 11/30. If that fits ArcFin's procurement windows, we'll prepare the DocuSign packet and the annex language around retention.

Related links: SIG mapping (https://drive.redwood.internal/ArcFin/SIG-CAIQ-mapping) — I've populated the first tab with evidence types. DocuSign template ready at https://docusign.example.com/abcdef123456 (will be sent once redlines are agreed).

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Trust & Compliance, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

[Attachment: Redline-DPA-ArcFin.docx (Word, 34KB); SOC2-report-2026Q2.pdf (PDF, 420KB); SIG-CAIQ-mapping.xlsx (Spreadsheet, 95KB)]

Subject: Re: Draft MAP & proposed security onboarding cadence (SOC 2 / SIG / DPA)

Thanks Michael / Emma — great alignment. Confirming next steps and timeline: 

- Evidence sprint: 2026-11-17 through 2026-11-27 (Redwood provides read-only exports and populated SIG mapping)
- SOC 2: Redwood will provide a redacted Type II report by EOD 11/17; full report available under NDA (we will share the intake instructions)
- DPA: Laura's redline delivered; Emma / ArcFin legal to send specific retention annex language by 11/19 so we can finalize a DocuSign packet the week of 11/22
- Demo: scheduled for 11/24 at 10:00 AM PST (engineering will show telemetry and data-handling runbook)

Acceptance criteria to move to procurement: SOC 2 (redacted Type II + evidence links), SIG mapping with evidence for key controls, signed DPA (or DocuSign in-flight) and a brief exec confirmation email.

I'll run the kickoff on 11/16 as proposed — calendar invite sent. If Emma prefers to review the DPA redline directly I can re-route Laura's tracked version to her.

Cheers — looking forward to closing this sprint and getting ArcFin into pilots.

—Neha
